name: NeRF Analogies
aliases: NeRF Analogies: Example-Based Visual Attribute Transfer
definition: A method to transfer visual attributes (appearance) from a source NeRF to a target NeRF using dense semantic correspondences derived from Vision Transformer (ViT) features, creating a 'NeRF analogy'.
summary: NeRF Analogies transfers appearance between scenes using semantic ViT features, avoiding geometric alignment by matching key components rather than reconstructing geometry.
